  "ruleNotes": [
    "Policy-only guidance, not authorization: current user RBAC, actor/session validation and route guards still apply.",
    "project means no affected branches. Project-wide writes affecting branches must use their database-resolved scopes; protectedBranch applies if any affected branch is protected.",
    "Compound actions merge with deny > approve > allow. approve authorizes only the bound request after human approval.",
    "project.create is account/organization bootstrap, independent of this project policy; organization access is required and the new project starts with full_access.",
    "db.query includes arbitrary SQL in v1; allow does not enforce SQL-level read-only access.",
    "branch_specific and customize authorize identically; customize is the same mode carrying explicit rules. full_access and read_only take no rules.",
    "branchDeveloperRules is a deprecated mirror of rules, and branch_developer of branch_specific. Both are still accepted on write and will be removed."

ruleNotes: Policy-only guidance, not authorization: current user RBAC, actor/session validation and route guards still apply.
project means no affected branches. Project-wide writes affecting branches must use their database-resolved scopes; protectedBranch applies if any affected branch is protected.
Compound actions merge with deny > approve > allow. approve authorizes only the bound request after human approval.
project.create is account/organization bootstrap, independent of this project policy; organization access is required and the new project starts with full_access.
db.query includes arbitrary SQL in v1; allow does not enforce SQL-level read-only access.
branch_specific and customize authorize identically; customize is the same mode carrying explicit rules. full_access and read_only take no rules.
branchDeveloperRules is a deprecated mirror of rules, and branch_developer of branch_specific. Both are still accepted on write and will be removed.
